core_rule: P3 center +/- half target 3dB log-frequency width
meaningful_shape_rule: matched status differs OR height difference >=6 dB OR width ratio between candidates >=2
match_rule: same kind within .25 decade; complete shift <=.02 decade,height <=3dB,width ratio .5..2
primary_outcome: P3 and V2 complete on SAME representative curve
scope: Exploratory 8 paired seeds, no auxiliary objective
sampling: Pure Python adaptive, original 180 log-cells each mass 1/180
